name: AuthenticateUser
description: Generic flow to authenticate user via OTP sent to cell or email

parameters.name: retry_flow
parameters.description: Flow to reboot if user wants to retry (default: authenticate-user)

parameters.name: cancel_flow
parameters.description: Flow to reboot if user cancels (default: cancel-process)

parameters.name: cell_number
parameters.description: Phone already supplied by the caller; forwarded so get-cell-or-email skips the contact prompt

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email already supplied by the caller; forwarded so get-cell-or-email skips the contact prompt

parameters.name: email_validator
parameters.description: OPTIONAL flow name. When supplied, it is called with {email} before an email OTP is sent and MUST set contact_valid=true to allow the send. Lets a tenant confirm the address resolves to an account without this flow knowing how. FAIL-CLOSED: if the validator does not set contact_valid, the send is blocked. The validator must end by completion — a RETURN step terminates ALL flows, not just the validator.

parameters.name: cell_validator
parameters.description: OPTIONAL flow name. Same contract as email_validator, called with {cell_number} before an SMS OTP is sent.

contact_valid.description: Whether the contact may receive an OTP. True when no validator applies; otherwise the validator must set it true (fail-closed).

unverified_contact.description: The contact that failed validation, phrased for the retry message ('the number 555…' / 'the email a@b.c'). Computed so cell and email share ONE rejection branch.

steps.value: !(((typeof cell_validator !== 'undefined' && cell_validator) && cell_number) || ((typeof email_validator !== 'undefined' && email_validator) && email))
